Identified as this saint because: A plate from the Russian Menaion Reader naming 'Назарий, Гервасий, Келсий и Протасий' — Nazarius, Gervasius, Celsus and Protasius, the Milanese martyrs — and numbered 02141, which in the series' church-year numbering (September is 01) is 14 October, this saint's day. Commons also files it in Category:Saint Protasius.
